No—the card is not ready for implementation as written.

Key issues:

- Lines 36 and 43 incorrectly introduce a separate `desktop.agentSubscriptionCosts` config. The subscription cost should instead be an optional field on the existing `AgentProfile`, such as `monthlySubscriptionCostUsd?: number`. This keeps commands, models, defaults, and pricing together.
- The UI description is inaccurate. `desktop.agentProfiles` uses the dedicated [agent_profiles_editor.tsx](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/components/config/agent_profiles_editor.tsx), selected explicitly in [config_value_editor.tsx](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/components/config/config_value_editor.tsx:318); it is not edited through the generic JSON editor.
- The card should require updates to the shared `AgentProfile` declaration and validation in [agent_profiles.d.mts](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/shared/agent_profiles.d.mts:1) and `shared/agent_profiles.mjs`, plus the existing profile form, desktop normalization/persistence, and their tests.
- The new price should be optional because “not configured” is valid. A configured value needs explicit validation—most likely a finite number greater than zero, since zero makes tokens-per-dollar undefined.
- Cost-per-card/action remains underspecified. Tokens-per-account-usage produces separate rates per time bucket and account-limit series. Line 46 refers to one “agent’s tokens-per-dollar rate,” but no single rate exists. The card must define which series and time range supplies that rate, or expose separate cost results per series.
- The 28-day prorating rule conflicts with the direct `monthlyCost / 100` rule unless prorating is genuinely required. The card should either remove the unused time-conversion requirement or define precisely where it applies.
- Acceptance criterion 51 names only `claude` and `codex`, while agent profiles support custom agents. Pricing should belong to every profile, while dollar calculations can remain unavailable when that agent has no corresponding account-usage metrics.

The principal correction should be: extend `desktop.agentProfiles` and `AgentProfile`; do not create another parallel configuration list. I made no edits.
